title: Second World Photo Continuation
summary: Keep the upper half photographic and extend a road, branch, reflection, or other source structure into a quiet paper world below. Tiny line figures interact with that same structure.
seoDescription: Extend your photo into a paper-and-doodle second world. Preserve the original scene, connect both halves, and choose how many tiny line figures may appear.
inputRequirement: Upload one photo. Make a separate poster for each upload; do not combine photos.
howToUse: Choose the line-figure limit, then copy the complete prompt and upload one photo to an image editor.
Use a vertical 3:4 canvas. Keep the upper half faithful to the photo and connect one source structure through the center into the lower half.
Keep the figure count within the selected limit. Add figures only when they help the interaction; add none if the photo already has strong human action.
Check the connection at the center, the preserved photo colors, the restrained paper world, and the short handwritten English caption.
exampleNotice: Four complete posters from Su’s X post are shown without cropping. The photo-and-paper layout is part of each result. Separate input photos and exact generation settings were not supplied.
verificationNotice: The source does not name the model used for these examples. This project has not independently generated or model-verified them.
adaptationNotice: The full English prompt is retained, with spacing and paragraph breaks restored for reading. Chinese is a complete translation. The figure selector only narrows the source’s 0–3 range; all scene, continuity, caption, and exclusion rules remain.
licenseNotice: Su shared the prompt and examples; original prompt authorship is not confirmed. No prompt or image license is stated. Rights remain with their holders, and commercial-use permission is unknown.
